title: break-rocks theme, format 2 (and format 1)
description: A theme of the format break-rocks-theme/2 (specs v48.0.0, contracts/themes.md § Format 2, theme-surfaces.feature; since design v4.0.0, specs v99.0.0 § Since v99.0.0: four theme surfaces, fixed radii, the readability mask), or of the format break-rocks-theme/1 (§ The theme object), which stays valid: a theme of the format 1 is read as a theme of the format 2 whose theme surfaces all take its palette. Expand then contract (D-203): what is withdrawn since v99.0.0 is still accepted, marked deprecated, and ignored when read (lib/theme readTheme): the former theme surfaces (read into their family, or gone), the border of a theme surface, surfaceRadius, shape (radius, stroke), typography.accent, the image slots and scrims other than page, pageHeader and mask. The structure only: the backend also checks at publication the contrast (raised to AA by theme surface), the size (64 KB without the images), the images (at most 8, each at most 5 MB, uploaded), the typefaces (approvedTypefaces) and the uniqueness of the name, and computes the scrims (the readability mask among them) and the screenshots, which an input may not carry (THEME_SCRIMS_COMPUTED, THEME_SCREENSHOTS_GENERATED); a served document carries them.

collection.description: The field collection of an official theme (SPORT…)

surfaceRadius.description: Deprecated since v99.0.0 (R-02): the radii are fixed by the platform; accepted, never refused (THEME_RADIUS_INVALID no longer raised), ignored

gradient.description: The accent gradient, 2 or 3 colors of the palette

shape.description: Deprecated since v99.0.0 (R-01, R-02): a theme sets no radius (radius) and no stroke width (stroke); accepted with any value, never refused (THEME_RADIUS_INVALID, THEME_STROKE_INVALID no longer raised), ignored

stickers.description: A set of stickers and emojis

name.description: 2 to 64 characters: letters, digits, "-", "_" or "."; a letter first; no successive "." nor final "." (mixed scripts and lookalikes: the backend)

uploadId.description: An upload id of the platform (requestImageUpload): never a URL nor a path (THEME_EXTERNAL_RESOURCE)

image.description: An image and its optional night variant (the day one used by night without it)

palette.description: A universe theme gives all six, a personal theme its accent only (checked by the backend with the use)

border.description: Deprecated since v96.0.0 (no longer drawn), v99.0.0: no border around a theme surface; accepted, ignored

surfaceColors.description: The colors of a theme surface in a variant; a color left out takes the palette (Socle: design tokens, surface)
